    • battle

      public static boolean battle(Player p, Pokemon op, Trainer t)
      # Battle: Takes the player and either a wild Pokemon or a Trainer, lets the player choose the next courses of action, then returns the winner of the battle.
      Parameters:
      p - Player, gets and changes player information, and uses the player's first Pokemon
      op - Pokemon, only passed if it's a wild Pokemon battle, null otherwise
      t - Trainer, only passed if it's a trainer battle, null otherwise
      Returns:
      WinCondition, returns true if the player wins, else returns false.

    • retryInput

      public static int retryInput(int min, int max)
      retryInput: takes the min and max input values, and only returns a user input between them.
      Parameters:
      min - Int, the minimum input value
      max - Int, the maximum input value
      Returns:
      choice Int, the input value from the user, loops until the input is between min and max

    • retryInput

      public static int retryInput(int min, int max, int ex)
      retryInput: same as other, but doesn't allow the excluded int value to be entered.
      Parameters:
      min - Int, min value
      max - Int, max value
      ex - Int, the input value that will be rejected
      Returns:
      choice Int, input from the user between min and max, excludes ex
